crossRefs.note: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go…
Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
“They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty in Baal, he died.
Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
translations.bsb: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
translations.kjv: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
